normalisation.ordering: sort atom signatures lexicographically for hashing only

object.description: Concrete depicted entity; id is local to a concept and value is the canonical class.

attribute.description: Property attached to an existing object id.

count.description: Explicit small count for an object class.

action.description: Canonical verb with existing subject and optional existing object id.

relation.description: Directed or explicitly symmetric spatial relation between existing object ids; between may use object2.

scene.description: Coarse environment/time concept independent from object identities.

frequency_bands.pilot_assignment: retain design label for stratification; compute separate empirical band from frozen training-only public corpus if P8 approves acquisition
frequency_bands.prohibition: do not call these population frequencies or use validation/test prompts to set boundaries

complexity_levels.1: one object atom and no relational structure
complexity_levels.2: object plus one attribute, count, or scene atom
complexity_levels.3: at least two objects plus one action or relation
complexity_levels.4: at least four atoms spanning at least three atom types
complexity_levels.5: at least six atoms spanning at least four atom types with action or relation structure

styles.literal: clear literal depiction, no text, no watermark
styles.watercolor: watercolor illustration, no text, no watermark
styles.paper_cut: paper-cut illustration, no text, no watermark

layouts.default: balanced composition while preserving all stated spatial relations
layouts.wide: wide composition while preserving all stated spatial relations
layouts.portrait: portrait composition while preserving all stated spatial relations

near_neighbour_rule.operation: replace exactly one atom signature with another atom of the same type
near_neighbour_rule.unchanged: all other atom signatures and referential links
forbidden: retroactive change after observing model output
implicit second semantic change in prompt

excluded_content: sexual content involving minors or ambiguous age
graphic violence or facilitation of violence
